content:
Alice M: T-minus 30m before the 00:00 UTC change window. Quick readiness sweep?
Ben R: All services green from infra side. Loadtests closed at 23:20.
Matt S: App staging Canary 3 running, smoke passed. Watchlist: embeddings-svc latency ~120ms (baseline 80ms).
Tia N: Noted. Is embeddings-svc in the same change window? that's the external vendor we flagged last week.
Alice M: It's used by the personalization job in the new feature rollout — yes same window. We planned a runtime fallback to small-model quantized variant if it spikes.
Kate L: Can we pin the model for the rollout? want to avoid auto-upgrades during the first 2 hours.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot triggered: create-pin request accepted. Pin request id: pin-20260321-09. Target: model-rex-v2.1 -> pinned on production.
Ben R: Confirming network egress rules for vendor endpoint are OK in prod VPC.
devops-oncall: devops-oncall: Observability retention increased to 72h for the release routes. Alert pages will escalate to oncall if error-rate > 2% for 5m.
Matt S: Running final dry-run: smoke script attached: ```/scripts/smoke.sh --canary 3 --timeout 60``` all green locally.
Tia N: Heads up — vendor status page shows intermittent AMQP errors in eu-west-1 around ~22:45. Might be transient.
Alice M: That's why we have the fallback. Matt, can you validate the fallback path now?
Matt S: Validating. Reproduced fallback locally with a tampered response: it returns fallback content within 120ms, quality tests pass on short prompts.
Tia N: Suggest keeping freeze extension on standby in case vendor degrades.
Kate L: I want the freeze extension pre-approved — if embeddings error-rate > 1.5% after rollout, we hold and escalate.
Ben R: +1 for automated hold. We can create a mute rule to stop new canaries and keep current traffic.
Alice M: Ok creating the operator checklist now. If hold triggers: 1) pause new canaries, 2) rollback canary to previous route (v2.0), 3) open postmortem channel.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for route /generate. Canary group: 3% traffic -> 10% over 20m -> 50% over 1h. Pin(s): pin-20260321-09 applied.
Matt S: Canary step 1 applied. No errors at 3%. Latency baseline +2ms.
Tia N: Vendor latency creeping up to 160ms on a subset of requests. Keep an eye.
devops-oncall: Alert: embeddings-svc error-rate 0.9% (now). Threshold for hold is 1.5%. No action yet.
Ben R: I'm pre-staging rollback plan: command to switch routing back to stable: `redwoodctl route set /generate --model model-rex-v2.0 --force-pin pin-20260210-04`
Alice M: Good. Also prepare release notes pointer for product and comms. Link: https://docs.internal/releases/2026-03-21-launch-notes (draft).
Kate L: Quick approval: product ok with staged rollout and pin.
Matt S: Canary 10% now. No user-facing errors. Monitoring dashboards are green except vendor latency.
Tia N: Vendor status updated: resolved in eu-west-1 ~now. Latency normalizing.
devops-oncall: No holds triggered. Freeze extension not needed at this time.
Alice M: Proceeding with next step. Reminder: no config changes to models or quantization during first 2h. Emergency unpin procedure only.
Ben R: Noted. If we need emergency unpin: steps: 1) ping #runbooks, 2) run `deploy-bot unpin pin-20260321-09 --reason \"emergency-unpin\"`, 3) verify traffic shifted.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary progressed to 50% as scheduled.
Matt S: Rolling to 100% now.
Tia N: Observability: adding a short eval set run to detect quality regressions post-rollout. Running prompt-set against active tokens.
Alice M: Launch complete, no holds. Thank you team. I'll post final readiness checklist and archive this thread. :tada:
Kate L: Great job. :thumbsup:
devops-oncall: devops-oncall: incident note: monitor embeddings vendor next 24h.
Matt S: I'll keep watch for 2h and will escalate if anything odd shows up.
Alice M: Thread archived at end of change window. Thanks everyone.
